source.attribution: NeqSim 3.20.0, SystemPrEos with AttractiveTermMollerup - the upstream this library is a port of, run from validation/neqsim/FlashTp.java
source.notes: Mollerup's correlation, three fitted parameters from the `schwartzentruber1..3` columns. A single pure component pins the compressibility rather than a two-phase split, because Mollerup's methane alpha is constant (its parameters are all zero) and a methane/n-butane feed stays single phase at every point tried.

derivation:
The driver was run for n-dodecane (nc12) at 500 K and 15 bar on SystemPrEos with `setAttractiveTerm(3)` - Mollerup, whose `alpha = 1 + p0 (Tc/T - 1) + p1 (T/Tc) ln(T/Tc) + p2 (T/Tc - 1)` with nc12's `[0.0789, -1.16, 0.0]`. NeqSim printed:

  beta 1.0
  Zl   0.11375239710073916
  Zv   0.11375239710073916

azoth reproduces the compressibility to 1e-17. `beta` is omitted as in the other single-phase cases.
